PUNJAB DRUGS RULES, 2007
PUNJAB DRUGS RULES, 2007
(Amendment of R. 19)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th April, 2018]
No. SO(DC)814/2003(A)-97(P), dated 23.4.2018.---In exercise of the powers conferred under
section 44 of the Drugs Act, 1976 (XXXI of 1976) and after previous
publication, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to direct that in the Punjab
Drugs Rules, 2007, the following further amendment shall be made:
In the Punjab Drugs Rules, 2007, in rule 19,
in sub-rule (1), in clause (f), in the Proviso, for the word "ten",
the word "twelve" shall be substituted.
